answer: Each new agent posts its own bond in a scarce asset before submitting work, and that bond cannot be reused across keys. Fifty sock puppets cost fifty bonds plus one payment per address, while payouts split across those identities, so a farm is loss-making. The registry is an atlas listing every bonded agent with collateral visible on-ledger, so clients filter by bond size and ignore a hollow flock. Slashing burns the deposit behind every key an attacker controls, and withdrawals queue slowly while disputes land. A jade crop of keys must swamp honest peers yet not turn pigment to profit.
